notes.title: Twitch Discount

notes.title: Half Price
notes.content: To be honest we had hoped the game would move more copies and might generate some traction through word of mouth as the art assets look a bit janky.  Please enjoy a 50% discount starting on the 11th if you have been thinking about trying it out!
